coder_result.remark: SOP is comprehensive and complete; Status Rules contains critical folder naming inconsistency (04_implementation vs 04_implementation_plans) that creates ambiguity for artifact routing. Correction required before approval.

findings.issue: Folder naming inconsistency for Implementation Plans artifacts between SOP and Status Rules

findings.impact: Runner artifact routing will fail due to multiple authoritative sources defining different folder paths. State machine enforcement cannot proceed without exact folder path alignment. This creates a gate-blocking failure for artifact discovery and validation.
